feed.title: Stamon - krivahtoo
feed.subtitle: A lightweight self-hosted status monitoring tool, written in Rust.

entry.title: Stamon v0.3.0: new checks, alerts and status pages
entry.summary: Stamon 0.3.0 is the biggest release so far. It grows Stamon from an HTTP checker into a monitoring tool that can watch most of a small team's stack, tell you when something breaks, and show your users what is going on.
